# Faction › The Cursed › Role

> Cursed factions include people and beings of a strange, supernatural, or dreadful nature, as well as factions dedicated to opposing those entities. Use the table below to reveal the role of a cursed faction.
>
> Datasworn `oracle_rollable:sundered_isles/faction/cursed/role` · 1d100

- [10] Artificers
- [5] Beast hunters
- [10] Constructs
- [5] Cultists
- [5] Deep-dwellers
- [5] Ghost hunters or occultists
- [5] Lycanthropes or shape changers
- [10] Monster hunters
- [10] Necromancers
- [5] Sorcerers or witches
